description: The AI's FIRE OVERWATCH answer prices the Hidden it would hand the opponent (13.09 + 15.08/15.09: snap shooting is ranged attacks, and a unit that made ranged attacks this turn is not Hidden in the opponent's Shooting phase that follows). Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive (P1 Custodes active, battle round 2): the Flash Gitz stand in a LIGHT terrain area (13.09 errata: light or dense hides) that every Ork-side model of theirs is within, so they are Hidden from the Custodes beyond their 15" detection range. The Ork player unticks 'Skip Overwatch' with a real click, the Custodes player ends the Movement phase with the phase button, the movement_phase_end window opens for Player 2, and K asks the AI what Player 2 should do. With F002 on (tests/bench_profiles/move_cover_on.json: HIDDEN_FORFEIT_PENALTY 3.0) the AI's notes say the Flash Gitz hold fire to stay Hidden for the opponent's Shooting phase (snap shot worth less than the Hidden forfeit); with the shipped defaults the same window has no Hidden line (nothing changes at HIDDEN_FORFEIT_PENALTY 0). Setup of the window copied from ai_suggestion_fire_overwatch.

steps.comment: the real click turned Skip Overwatch OFF
the Movement phase waits for the end-of-phase window
offered to the NON-active player only
the Hidden Flash Gitz are offered FIRE OVERWATCH
K while the defender's dialog (modal) is open

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("U_FLASH_GITZ_A holds fire to stay Hidden for the opponent's Shooting phase")
steps.comment: the AI's notes: the snap shot is worth less than the Hidden forfeit
the window is still open: K only suggested
